summary: Recorded the account for the client-change receipt 2caa49e2796e4a19884ddafd38610f91 (47 events, exit 0) and closed the last open channel: comparison 0 is violated with a valid witness at parsed index 44 — the node leading on a one-voter reconstruction (against the three voters recorded at index 110 in its own log) completed a client AddVoter with prevIndex 0 and ended with two voters, one of them a fresh instance that was not part of the configuration it replaced (comparison 3 holds there), while the two peers that had held votes came back with none and adopted the rewritten membership (comparison 2 holds: both adopted, zero votes between them); the flag-disabled control could not lead and the change failed with "node is not the leader" (comparison 1 holds at parsed index 46). I marked the registered gap resolved with that executed basis, cited the receipt from both source-grounded entries and dropped the "unexecuted" caveat from the reconstructed-quorum fact, added a fact for the rewritten membership, and restated the question's discriminator as boundaries only — no conjecture is left undecided, with the natural next boundary being a partition that leaves the rewritten and replaced configurations with separate quorums and leadership, which is deliberately not claimed. Remaining limitations are unchanged otherwise: in-memory single-process execution, single-shot windows, one or two restarted instances per case, and the earlier synthesized-campaign case now superseded for the same grant.
